OnEnqueuePlayVfx.rationale: `NFireBurningVfx.Create(...)` plus `CreatureCmd.TriggerAnim(Owner.Creature, "PowerUp", ...)` (Pyre.cs:32-37). Pure presentation, hoisted out of OnPlay into the enqueue slot -- the same shape as card/hellraiser's and card/inflame's. Out of scope per the shared contract.

ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Pyre.cs:22-25) == cost 2 / POWER / RARE / SELF.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<PyrePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Pyre.cs:29) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, PyrePower, self._energy_gain, applier=ctx.player)`. The C# OnPlay body carries no animation at all because it was moved to OnEnqueuePlayVfx, so the sim's bare one-liner is a complete match rather than an omission.
